description: This file defines the tlInputParameter class and associated helper classes for managing, validating, and normalizing input parameters fetched from HTTP POST/GET/REQUEST sources in the TestLink project. It provides mechanisms for parameter type support, validation, normalization, and access.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Helper class for handling input parameters fetched from request sources, supporting normalization, validation, and retrieval.

classes.name: tlParameterInfo
classes.description: Helper class holding source and name info about a specific input parameter.

classes.name: tlStringValidationInfo
classes.description: Helper class for validating string inputs, including trimming, length constraints, regex, and custom functions.

classes.name: tlIntegerValidationInfo
classes.description: Helper class for validating integer inputs, including range checks and custom validation functions.

classes.name: tlArrayValidationInfo
classes.description: Helper class for validating arrays of values, applying element-specific validation.

classes.name: tlCheckBoxValidationInfo
classes.description: Helper class for validating checkbox-like boolean inputs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing input parameter object with parameter info and optional validation info, fetching, normalizing, and validating the parameter.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the validated and normalized value of the parameter if fetched and valid, null otherwise.
